module: Node "EndScreen Drag Time Slip" (repeat_instant, color ui). Displays the timing slip (time slip) of a drag race on the end screen. Input flow, output flow (chainFlow).
notes: The warning log uses the variable logTag, which is not defined in this file (nil value).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Gets gameplay_drag_dragBridge.createTimeslipData() and adds it to the panel via modules.ui:addUIElement; without data, adds the empty panel and logs a warning.
